title: Harbor and Spotted Seals Telemetry Data
description:
Data Type: Mammals; Purpose to support the monitoring of and analysis of data from satellite telemetered spotted seals and harbor seals. Data is received from Service ARGOS. Foxpro is used to house and screen raw data. GIS is used to perform analysis of data. One such application is to investigate the relationship between ice and spotted seals and the relationship between harbor seals and finer scale habitat characteristics, including bathymetry.

Deposited content: descriptive metadata only; underlying research data are not included.
